about: Hold-out questions for judging retrieval changes. Written with AI assistance on 2026-11-02, before any retrieval change, from docs/corpus: each question asks for one fact, and 'marker' is the phrase that fact is quoted by (whitespace-insensitive; tests/test_retrieval_holdout.py checks it occurs in 'source'). 'direct' questions (H01-H26) use the document's own words; the baseline found them too easy, so 'indirect' ones (I01-I20) paraphrase, the way the failing golden questions do. They are separate from the 40 golden questions so that changes are not tuned against the questions they are scored on. One author, 46 questions: a sanity check, not a benchmark.
